    def split_date(text):
        """Split a date string into year, month and day strings.
        
        Supports the following formats:
        - 'YYYY-MM-DD' (ISO format with dashes)
        - 'YYYY/MM/DD' (ISO format with slashes)
        - 'DD.MM.YYYY' (day-first with dots)
        """
        text = text.strip()
        
        # Check for dots (day-first format: DD.MM.YYYY)
        if "." in text:
            day, month, year = text.split(".")
            return year, month, day
        
        # Check for slashes (YYYY/MM/DD)
        if "/" in text:
            year, month, day = text.split("/")
            return year, month, day
        
        # Default: dashes (YYYY-MM-DD)
        year, month, day = text.split("-")
        return year, month, day


def parse_date(text):
    """Parse an import date into a (year, month, day) tuple of ints."""
    year, month, day = split_date(text)
    return (int(year), int(month), int(day))

"""Shared string helpers. Used by billing, imports and reports."""


def split_date(text):
    """Split a date string into year, month and day strings.
    
    Supports formats:
    - YYYY-MM-DD (ISO format)
    - YYYY/MM/DD (slash format)
    - DD.MM.YYYY (day-first dotted format)
    """
    text = text.strip()
    
    # Try to determine the format and parse accordingly
    if "-" in text:
        # ISO format: YYYY-MM-DD
        year, month, day = text.split("-")
    elif "/" in text:
        # Slash format: YYYY/MM/DD
        year, month, day = text.split("/")
    elif "." in text:
        # Day-first dotted format: DD.MM.YYYY
        day, month, year = text.split(".")
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unrecognized date format: {text}")
    
    return year, month, day
